name: 0.20mm Non-planar top @MINI 0.6
description: 0.20mm Standard for Prusa MINI/MINI+ with a 0.6 mm nozzle, curved top shells; auto chooses the shell count (2 to 6) and pattern for each curved area, with ironing left off. Thin curved parts (up to 3 mm) print in curved layers throughout on meshes with holes; closed meshes keep planar interiors. Curved tops run at 150% of the top surface speed. Uses the shared prusa-mini head.
